GrowthCred · South Africa

Practical AI training for South African business owners.

You don't need another AI course. You need AI doing the work your business already does. Proposals. Research. Follow-ups. The admin that lands on your desk every week. That's what I train owners to build, from Rosebank, Johannesburg.

By Phila Ngwenya · Reviewed 20 September 2026

Choose the kind of help you need

There are three ways to work with me. Pick the one that fits your week.

The one-day workshop is guided building. You bring your laptop and real work. You build alongside us. You leave with it running.

Done for you is separate. You tell us what's stuck, and we map and build the workflows with your team. We agree scope, delivery and who looks after what before you get a quote.

Got a team? Tell us the roles, the group size and where you are. We'll tell you straight whether we can meet the brief. And the workshop doesn't lock you into a later programme. One day is one day.

What you practise

You start by listing the tasks that repeat. Then you write down how your business works. Your services. Your clients. Your tone. Then you use that to draft a proposal, a follow-up or an answer to an internal question.

Then you compare it with how you do it now. Is it faster? Is it better? Only then do you decide what to automate.

You're building a way of working, not a folder of prompts. And you still check prices, client promises and anything that leaves the building. The AI drafts. You decide.

Training that has already run

I've given seven AI talks at WeWork Johannesburg. The first Operator Intensive at WeWork Rosebank sold out all five seats. Every owner in that room ran a business that depended entirely on them. They left that day with working systems.

After one working session, Macaela Oor of Demure International wrote: “My Claude has been operating a lot better since the last session.” Same tool. Better context. That's the whole trick.

Who is it for?

You run a business. You're not technical. You've got roughly 3 to 50 people, and you still do too much of the admin yourself. That's who I built this for.

You need to be comfortable in a browser. And you need to be willing to work on your own business on the day. That's it.

One honest note. This is practical business training. It's not a programming qualification or an accredited machine-learning course. I don't claim any accreditation.

Format, tools and next dates

The workshop is one full day, online. You get the dates, times and joining link when you register. Want a session for your team? Contact us and we'll confirm a format that fits your brief.

Bring a laptop and a work example that isn't sensitive. Ask us for the tool list before you buy any plan. I won't promise every tool is free, because they aren't.

What does training cost?

The workshop is R990 at the founding rate. Before you pay, confirm the next session, the booking terms, VAT and any tool costs with us. Custom builds and team sessions get scoped and quoted separately.
